note: Billboards along SunnyBay's main roads (City job A). slots: how many boards stand in the city (8 to 12). Each ad: brand (the big word), line (the small one), image (optional: a picture drawn over the whole board, 2:1, e.g. /img/ads/woza.webp; empty draws the brand and line in bg/fg colours), link (optional: opens when a player taps the board and then Visit), start and end (dates, YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive; outside them the ad is not shown), boards (how many boards it takes, default 1). A board with no ad shows a University of Mzansi house ad (house: the line for those, {house} is the house's name). Brands allowed: Woza, Lifecup, Greenway.
